notes.title: Hot Rod Mayhem is available now on Steam!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267135/624f00ca7fc3a5ee16d8647d4e9259c7c33b1683.png"]

🏁 Hot Rod Mayhem is Now Available on Steam! 🏁


We’ve crossed the finish line, Tiny Champions! You can now pick up our wild kart racer at a 20% discount. Challenge yourself alone or go head-to-head in a crazy couch-coop. 

▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄

What’s in the Launch
Full access to all tracks, cars, and cosmetics. Unlock everything by completing the cups and challenges.

Our hardest mode available: Crazy Mode.

Trials. Challenge yourself to specific trials to prove you’re the Tiny Champion.

Steam Achievements.

And more! You’ll just have to hit the tracks to find out everything 🏎️💨


▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄▀▄


However you play, remember: HAVE FUN!

See you on the track, Champions!

🏁 Join the community on Discord[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062040/Hot_Rod_Mayhem/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: EVENT ENDED - Become a Crazy Mode Champion in the latest community event!
notes.content:
Event Ended! Thank you to everyone who shared their screenshots!

Share with us your fastest time in Crazy Mode to win the grand prize either on Discord or on social media (tag us @CasualBrothers). Enter with a video, screenshot or even a photo from your phone of your fastest time in Crazy Mode on any track.


Ways to Win:
⏲️ Time Challenge:

🥇 The player with the fastest time in Crazy Mode will win a $50 USD Dollar Steam Gift Card and a key to a copy of any Casual Brothers titles on the console of their choice.

🎟️ All who enter will have a random chance to win either:

A $25 USD gift card.

A copy of any of Casual Brothers titles + Hot Rod Mayhem for their console of choice.

A copy of Hot Rod Mayhem for the console of their choice.

Sign up for the playtest to try Crazy Mode!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062040/Hot_Rod_Mayhem/?curator_clanid=45594706"][/dynamiclink]

Guidelines

Must beat at least one track on Crazy Mode

Share either an image of their time or video on either Discord or social media (and tag us) to enter

This contest is open to PC and Console players

Grand prize winners must be in a country that can receive USD Steam gift cards. No third party sites.

Players may re-post their times if they beat it later

Contest begins June 18th - June 29th


Good luck on the tracks everyone!

notes.title: Hot Rod Mayhem Coming to Steam this Summer!
notes.content:
Hello Champions! 

We come with exciting news! 

We are happy to share that Hot Rod Mayhem is releasing on PC this summer! Check out the demo today on Steam or, if you prefer console you can play the full release now on

 Nintendo Switch
 PlayStation
 Xbox

Casual Brothers Games has been making titles for over 10 years, working for other publishers. We are proud to be creating and publishing something of our own! We believe Hot Rod Mayhem is a wonder to play with friends up to 4 players in split screen, and we think this is going to bring joy to lots of friends all over the world.

 We hope to connect with you by bringing our unique take with Hot Rod Mayhem! Feel free to share the love on social media or get in touch with our community Discord. 

See you on the track soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3062040/Hot_Rod_Mayhem/
